title: How to Cancel Cursor Pro — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel your Cursor Pro subscription in 60 seconds. Downgrade to the free Hobby plan. Steps to stop the $20/mo charge.
intro: Cursor Pro cancellation is done through their settings page. The free Hobby plan still gives you limited AI completions, so you can keep using the editor without paying.

steps.title: Open Cursor settings
steps.text: Visit cursor.com/settings while signed in, or open Cursor IDE → click your avatar → Settings/Account.

steps.title: Navigate to Subscription/Billing
steps.text: Find the "Subscription" or "Billing" section in your account settings. You'll see your current plan and renewal date.

steps.title: Click "Cancel Plan" or "Downgrade"
steps.text: Click the cancel or downgrade option. Cursor may ask for feedback or offer a retention deal.
steps.tip: The Hobby (free) plan still includes 2000 completions and 50 slow premium requests per month.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Confirm your cancellation. Pro features remain active until the end of your billing cycle, then you switch to the Hobby plan.

warnings: Cursor Hobby plan has limited fast requests — heavy usage may hit caps quickly.
Your projects, settings, and extensions are preserved on the free plan.
If you paid annually, check the refund policy for unused months.
Business/Team plan members should contact their admin for cancellation.

faqs.q: What's included in Cursor's free plan?
faqs.a: The Hobby plan gives you 2000 code completions per month, 50 slow premium requests, and basic features. Pro ($20/mo) adds 500 fast premium requests and unlimited completions.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Cursor?
faqs.a: Contact Cursor support (hi@cursor.com) for refund requests. They typically accommodate recent charges, especially for unused portions of annual plans.

faqs.q: Will I lose my settings and extensions?
faqs.a: No. All your Cursor settings, keybindings, extensions, and project configurations are preserved regardless of plan.

faqs.q: What's a free alternative to Cursor?
faqs.a: VS Code with GitHub Copilot Free, Codeium extension, or Windsurf (Codeium's IDE) offer similar AI coding assistance on free tiers.

refund.details: Contact hi@cursor.com for refund requests. They generally accommodate requests for unused portions, especially on annual plans.

retentionTactics: Cursor may offer a discount or extended trial of Pro features.
